liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **gd84-04-29 01Crowd Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd84-04-29 02 Feel Like A Stranger**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd84-04-29 03 Friend Of The Devil**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd84-04-29 04 CC Rider**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd84-04-29 05 Bird Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd84-04-29 06 Hell In A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd84-04-29 07 West LA Fadeaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd84-04-29 08 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-04-29.140355.fob.sbd.composite.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 189 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1984-04-29.167058.neumann.u87.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 189 min [4]
- **gd1984-04-29.149684.mke2002.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 20 songs; 184 min [6]
- **gd1984-04-29.senn421.pauline.miller.91146.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 169 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [8]. Said about its sound: High-quality audience recording with an incredible, energy-filled performance [18]
- **gd84-04-29.beyer.miller.15390.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 167 min; rated 2.25/5 by 8 [9]. Said about its sound: Post-Terrapin jam features gamelan drum themes; pre-Truckin' section is loud and feedbacky [15]
- **gd1984-04-29.149679.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 20 songs; 177 min [10]
- **gd1984-04-29.125853.crown_pzm.scarletdog.flac16**: source not stated; 12 songs; 98 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [14]. Said about its sound: Excellent sound with good balance and separation from a behind-stage vantage point [25]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was a sixteen-year-old high school student attending their first Grateful Dead concert [16]
- Reviewer held general admission floor tickets for their first live Grateful Dead experience [23]
- Cassidy and Let It Grow in one set occurred in about thirty-three shows [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-04-29.140355.fob.sbd.composite.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: 1st Set: Rob Eaton's (FOB) Master Audience Cassette; Neumann U-87 mics > Sony TC-D5M (21st Row, DFC)> Panasonic SV-3800 16/482nd Set: Master Soundboard… [1]
- **gd1984-04-29.167058.neumann.u87.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes (21st row, DFC); Neumann U87 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: Rob Eaton recorded and transferred; d5scott and Executive Crew provided Sennheiser sources [4]
- **gd1984-04-29.149684.mke2002.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Recorded by: Executive Crew: Chris Kidwell; Sean Murtha; Tom Pinney; Kyle Holbrook; Gary Steel; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Source: MAUD CA: Sennheiser MKE2002 Binaurals mounted on dummy head 90 feet from stage DFC (1st row 2nd section)>Sony TCD5M > TDK MA 90s No Dolby - Master copy… [6]. Also: Sennheiser MKE2002 binaural mics used; tape chopped between songs to save space [6]
- **gd1984-04-29.senn421.pauline.miller.91146.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rick Pauline; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell XLIIS-90) D [8]
- **gd84-04-29.beyer.miller.15390.sbeok.shnf**: source: (FOB/14th Row) 3 Beyer M160's -> Cm -> Sound Forge -> CD -> EAC -> SHN [9]
- **gd1984-04-29.149679.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Recorded by: Executive Crew: Chris Kidwell; Sean Murtha; Tom Pinney; Kyle Holbrook; Gary Steel; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Source: MAUD CA: Beyer M201's (Hypercardioid) 90 feet from stage 6'high DFC (1st row second section from stage)> Sony TCD5M > TDK MA90x2.5; No Dolby - Master… [10]
- **gd1984-04-29.125853.crown_pzm.scarletdog.flac16**: source: Set 2 only; Master: 2 Crown PZM-315 Microphones and Sony TC-D5m Cassette Master microphones spread about 20 feet behind stage, obstructed view seating; [14]
